clue.text: Name changes so he forgets

indicators.note: changes tells us the letters of the word name are rearranged

parts.note: sic is Latin for thus or so, used to mark a quotation as printed

explanation.surface: Someone changes their name, so presumably he forgets who he was.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changes' is the anagram signal; 'he forgets' defines a noun, a person with memory loss, not a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: As a noun the word means a person suffering from memory loss, someone who forgets.

clue.text: Australian snake exists in poison-free state

parts.note: a seps is a serpent in classical lore, also a snake-like lizard
is means exists

explanation.surface: An Australian snake that lives without venom.
explanation.walkthrough: SEPS is an obscure snake from classical writing.
explanation.definitionFit: Asepsis is the absence of harmful microbes, a state free of infection.

clue.text: Simply natural water rises

indicators.note: rises in a down clue means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: Evian is a brand of bottled mineral water

explanation.surface: Plain spring water bubbling up.
explanation.definitionFit: Naive describes someone artless and unaffected, simple and natural in manner.

clue.text: He guards ploughed acres with triumph

indicators.note: ploughed fields are churned up, so the letters of acres are turned over

parts.note: to crow is to boast in triumph

explanation.surface: A farmer protects his tilled fields with a victory.
explanation.definitionFit: A straw figure stands in a field protecting crops from birds.

clue.text: Short snack

definitions.meaning: brief and to the point, terse
a thin fried potato slice, a snack

explanation.surface: A quick bite.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means curt and brisk, and is also the British name for a potato chip.

clue.text: Support near perfect vineyard with money

indicators.note: near perfect means not quite complete, so the last letter of the synonym is dropped

parts.note: full can mean complete or perfect
a cru is a French vineyard or its wine

explanation.surface: Someone backs an almost ideal wine estate with cash.
explanation.definitionFit: A fulcrum is the pivot point on which a lever rests, its support.

clue.text: Digital in the extreme!

parts.note: digital refers to fingers, the digits, and the extreme is the very end of one

explanation.surface: Something wholly computerised.
explanation.definitionFit: The end of a finger is literally the extremity of a digit.

clue.text: I sell twisted yarn

indicators.note: twisted suggests the letters are wound into a new order

explanation.surface: A trader admits selling spun thread.
explanation.definitionFit: Lisle is a fine, strong cotton thread used for stockings.

clue.text: Take Grade one playing this instrument

parts.note: R, from Latin recipe meaning take, heads prescriptions

indicators.note: playing suggests the letters are performed in a different order

explanation.surface: Pass a Grade 1 music exam on this.
explanation.walkthrough: R is the prescription symbol for 'take'. 'playing' rearranges GRADE ONE into EEDORGAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A reed organ, such as a harmonium, sounds through vibrating metal reeds.

clue.text: As an alias Keir changed second name first

indicators.note: first puts the second and name pieces in front of the rearranged name

parts.note: mo is a moment, a second

indicators.note: changed tells us the letters of Keir are rearranged

explanation.surface: Keir adopted a pseudonym, putting a different forename first.
explanation.definitionFit: A moniker is an informal name or nickname, an assumed name.

clue.text: Hair removal finds Greek character overcome by joy

indicators.note: overcome by puts the Greek letter beneath, here inside, the word for joy

parts.note: elation is great joy
pi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A Greek person is overwhelmed with happiness at a discovery about hair.
explanation.definitionFit: Epilation is the technical term for removing body hair by the roots.

clue.text: In flight geese pelt around Spain

indicators.note: around has the word for pelt placed round the letter for Spain

parts.note: a pelt is an animal's skin
E is the international vehicle code for Spain

explanation.surface: Geese flying over Spain, their feathers buffeting around.
explanation.definitionFit: A skein is the collective noun for wild geese flying in formation.

clue.text: European root crop

explanation.surface: A European root vegetable.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a Scandinavian person and the rutabaga, a root vegetable.

clue.text: Tut! That's fantastic English epic work

indicators.note: fantastic suggests something wildly altered, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone tuts in admiration at a marvellous English epic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fantastic' rearranges E plus EPIC into PIECE. 'Tut' is the obscure dialect word, from mining, for work paid by the amount done; it is not the exclamation.
explanation.definitionFit: Tut is a dialect term for labour paid by quantity produced rather than time spent.

clue.text: Flight boost?

parts.note: flight here is a flight of stairs, and the boost is a mechanical lift up it, not air travel

explanation.surface: Something that helps an aircraft take off.
explanation.definitionFit: A motorised chair on a rail carries a person up a staircase, giving a lift up a flight.

clue.text: Can a mule cantering around be contracted as a mode of transport?

indicators.note: cantering around suggests the letters frisk about into a new order
contracted means shortened, so the little word be loses its last letter

explanation.surface: Could a galloping mule be hired as a means of travel?
explanation.walkthrough: 'contracted' looks like part of the definition but shortens the word be to its first letter; 'cantering around' then shuffles the whole pool.
explanation.definitionFit: An emergency vehicle carries sick people to hospital, a form of transport.

clue.text: Drug given by posh fellow replacing playwright's heart

indicators.note: replacing says the new pieces take the place of a letter
heart picks out the middle letter of the playwright's name

parts.note: Henrik Ibsen was the Norwegian playwright
U means upper-class, posh
prof, a professor, may be a college fellow

explanation.surface: A medicine given by an upper-class academic in place of a dramatist's core.
explanation.walkthrough: U and PROF replace the S at the heart of IBSEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Ibuprofen is a common anti-inflammatory painkiller.

clue.text: Does sweet girl want this kind of Daddy?

definitions.text: Does sweet girl want this kind of Daddy?

parts.words: Does sweet girl want this kind of Daddy?
parts.note: a rich older man who lavishes gifts on a young woman is known by a sweet word plus Daddy

explanation.surface: Asking whether a young woman is after a wealthy older benefactor.
explanation.definitionFit: A rich older man funding a younger partner is called a sugar daddy, and sweet hints at the sweetener.

clue.text: Pilot small stricken steamer to haven ultimately

indicators.note: stricken suggests something battered and broken, so the letters are rearranged
ultimately takes the last letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A pilot guides a small damaged ship to a safe port at last.
explanation.definitionFit: A steersman is the person who steers a vessel, as a pilot does.

clue.text: Steer front of boat round bend in river

parts.note: a steer is a castrated bull, an ox
the bow is the forward end of a vessel

explanation.surface: Guiding the prow of a boat around a river bend.
explanation.definitionFit: An oxbow is a U-shaped loop in a meandering river, a rounded bend.

clue.text: Sketch remote lake in Europe

parts.note: out can mean remote, as in an out-of-the-way place

explanation.surface: Drawing a distant lake somewhere on the continent.
explanation.definitionFit: An outline is a rough drawing showing only the main contours.

clue.text: The men put away the last of many

indicators.note: put away here suggests the letters are cleared off and reordered, signalling an anagram

explanation.surface: The men tidied away the final item from a large pile.
explanation.definitionFit: Umpteen means very many, so the umpteenth is the latest in a long series.

clue.text: Cutter's opening in deck leads to engine turbines

parts.note: a hatch is an opening in a ship's deck

indicators.note: leads to takes the first letters of the following words

explanation.surface: A ship's hatch gives access to its engines and turbines.
explanation.definitionFit: A hatchet is a small axe, a tool for chopping.

clue.text: Points awarded after set skiing manoeuvres

indicators.note: after places the points word behind the word for set

parts.note: a TV set is informally a tele
marks are points given in a test

explanation.surface: Judges give scores once a series of ski turns is done.
explanation.definitionFit: A telemark is a skiing turn with the knee bent, named after a Norwegian region.

clue.text: It's essential for commercials to provide thanks when abroad

indicators.note: the essential part of a word is its core, so the answer sits inside it

explanation.surface: Advertising must give gratitude to overseas customers.
explanation.definitionFit: Merci is French for thank you.

clue.text: Long-suffering Saint Oswald's first to join leaders in island church

indicators.note: first takes the opening letter of the Northumbrian king's name
leaders in takes the first letters of the next two words

explanation.surface: Saint Oswald endures, joining the heads of an island church.
explanation.definitionFit: A stoic person bears hardship patiently without complaint.

clue.text: Some strive to attract attention

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some people try hard to be noticed.
explanation.definitionFit: To rivet someone is to hold their gaze or interest completely.

clue.text: Amazon washing away a sign

indicators.note: washing away means the named letter is removed

parts.note: a virago is a fierce warlike woman, an Amazon

explanation.surface: The great river eroding a landmark.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Amazon' looks like the river; it is the mythical warrior woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Virgo is one of the twelve signs of the zodiac.

clue.text: Hidden part of target

definitions.meaning: ... can mean concealed or private, as in ... feelings
the ring just outside the bullseye

explanation.surface: A concealed section of a target.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means private or concealed, and in archery or shooting it names a ring near the centre.

clue.text: Force forwards as French go back to border

indicators.note: go back means the little word go is read in reverse

parts.note: taken as written
a march is a border region, as in the Welsh Marches

explanation.surface: French troops are driven back to the frontier.
explanation.definitionFit: To frogmarch someone is to push them forward with arms held behind.

clue.text: In the end Chinese flagrantly ignore this part of the upper atmosphere

indicators.note: In the end selects the final letter of the following word
flagrantly suggests outrageous disorder, so the letters of ignore are rearranged

explanation.surface: Eventually, Chinese officials blatantly disregard this layer of the sky.
explanation.definitionFit: The E-layer is a stratum of the ionosphere that reflects radio waves.

clue.text: Associate with criminal class

parts.note: con is short for a convict, a criminal
a sort is a kind or class

explanation.surface: Mixing with the lawbreaking set.
explanation.definitionFit: To consort is to keep company with someone, usually disreputable.
